description: This Java source file defines the `MongoMetricsReporter` class, which extends `AbstractHealthCheckingActor`. The class is responsible for periodically reporting metrics related to MongoDB, including collecting and storing maximum timer durations. It manages subscriptions to a pub/sub topic and provides health status reports.

classes.name: MongoMetricsReporter
classes.description: A final class extending `AbstractHealthCheckingActor`, responsible for periodically reporting MongoDB metrics and health status. It subscribes to a pub/sub topic and manages a deque of recent maximum timer values.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props for instantiating `MongoMetricsReporter` with specified resolution, history size, and pub/sub mediator.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Defines message handlers, including timer ticks and subscription acknowledgment.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Triggers health status retrieval and update.

methods.name: renderStatusInfo
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo object reflecting current health status.

methods.name: renderStatusDetailMessage
methods.description: Creates a detailed status message including current metrics in JSON format.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Generates a `MongoMetrics` object containing current metrics data.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Handles timer tick events, updating the maximum timer values deque.

methods.name: subscribeForTopicWithoutGroup
methods.description: Subscribes the actor to a pub/sub topic using the mediator.

methods.name: subscribeAck
methods.description: Handles subscription acknowledgment messages, logging successful subscription.
